The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

translations.web: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.
translations.bsb: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
translations.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
translations.asv: The good man out of his good treasure bringeth forth good things: and the evil man out of his evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
